reads.source: lib/studio-api.ts getDraft/listDrafts; localStorage fw-studio drafts[]; normalize() in lib/studio.ts:520 drops unknown fields

fields.name: id
fields.note: client-made by uid(): Math.random base36, 8 chars (studio.ts:480); server should issue/accept

fields.name: name
fields.note: maxLength 32 in the UI, trimmed by specOf at submit; default 'Untitled style'; newStyle default '<template name> remix'

fields.name: status
fields.note: a draft is always 'draft'

fields.name: base
fields.note: slug of a registered package (lib/engine/packages.ts getManifest) or the literal 'blank'; normalize returns null (draft unreadable) when the slug is unknown

fields.name: theme
fields.note: Partial of {ground, ground2, ink, muted, accent, soft, line, display, body, script: string; italic, upper: boolean; track, scale: number}; colours are #rrggbb or rgba(); display/body are CSS font-family strings; {} when untouched

fields.name: seen
fields.note: the base's own look as the canvas last read it; a client-side cache written by the canvas (update tag 'seen'), not authored; excluded by specOf at submit

fields.name: scenes
fields.note: sceneKey: 'opening' | 'cover' | a chapter type (letter, reasons, memory, story, voices, note, blessing, timeline, details, film, favourites, credits, links) | 'ending' | '*' (ALL: holds on every scene)

fields.name: scenes[k].layers
fields.note: layerKey: '<word>#<n>' or '<word>#*' (word: title, words, eyebrow, photo, ground, action, or package-specific), a bare known word (old drafts), or an added thing's id. LayerEdit = Motion {in, out: string; speed, delay, end: ms; ease: soft|even|snap|bounce|gentle|sharp|back|drift; params: Record<string,number>; curve: [n,n,n,n]; stagger: ms; loop{kind,speed,amount}; scroll{kind,amount}; touch{kind,amount}; path{d,speed,turn,loop}} + {name, hidden, locked, opacity %, font (pair key), size %, colour, align start|center|end, shape own|square|soft|arch|circle|polaroid|torn, fit fill|whole, border, borderColour, shadow, tilt, drift none|zoom|drift, colours Record<string,string>, weight, italic, kase own|upper|lower|title, track, lineH, textFx{outline,shadow,glow,highlight,grad,stamp}}

fields.name: scenes[k].added
fields.note: stacking order, last on top; items without numeric x are dropped by normalize

fields.name: scenes[k].layout
fields.note: {mode auto|free, stack{dir column|row, gap, pad[4], align start|center|end|stretch, justify start|center|end|between, wrap, max, wide(Partial stack)}, board portrait|landscape, fit contain|cover, groups Record<id,{stack, flow, name}>}; absent means free, as before

fields.name: scenes[k].look
fields.note: per-scene look over the style's

fields.name: art
fields.note: Asset {id, kind image|sound|model, name, size bytes, url}; normalize drops items with no url

fields.name: soundSet
fields.note: default SOUND 70/600/900

fields.name: made
fields.note: {kinds: string[] (lib/catalog slugs), occasions: Record<kind, occasionSlug[]> (empty list or absent kind = every occasion the base fits), best: portrait|landscape|either}

fields.name: tags
fields.note: {mood: string[], palette: string, family: string}

fields.name: still
fields.note: what plays under reduced motion; anything other than 'none' normalises to 'fade'

fields.name: fallback
fields.note: required by a check when base dimension is drawn or 3d; must be a flat package

fields.name: holds
fields.note: written by the canvas measuring layout (update tag 'holds'); read by the 'orient' check; client-measured

fields.name: poster
fields.type: {frame: opening|cover|ending, src?: string url, name?: string}
fields.note: src is a data URL today (uploadPoster)

fields.name: from
fields.note: what it was built on; house=true for firstwish packages, else another creator's template (25% royalty line in builtOn)

fields.name: brief
fields.note: what the creator typed to AI

fields.name: piece
fields.note: absent = whole style

fields.name: moments
fields.note: edits to openings/endings tried and put by

fields.name: at
fields.note: client Date.now(); saveDraft overwrites it with Date.now() and drafts list sorts by it desc

fields: id string; kind shape|artwork|effect|text|model|photo|element|three; what string (bank item id, fx key, asset id for artwork/model); name string
x,y centre in % of scene; w width % (all number, required); h number? (share of width)

pins {x,y: start|center|end|stretch|scale, min?, max?}; flow {order, w hug|fill|number, h?, self?, grow?, parent?, out?, at?{x,y,w..}}; bind (from cover|wish|chapter|photo + field + n?); free Partial<Record<portrait|landscape, Place>>
flipX, flipY, skew, tiltX, tiltY, group; fill {kind solid|gradient|picture, grad?, art? asset id}; drop {x,y,blur,colour}; glass; mask; dash

addedThingShape.limits: BUDGET: files 2.5 MB total, 3 non-calm effects and 10 added things per scene (checked client-side in checks()); FILE_MAX image 400KB, sound 900KB, model 900KB

reads.note: The whole style is one document with open-ended nested JSON; client treats it opaquely except normalize(). Stored data is the draft exactly as above; unknown fields are dropped on read. Editor reads it once at mount (Editor.tsx:56) and never refetches; a missing id (getDraft not-found) shows the 'gone' page.

fields.name: credits
fields.note: AI credits left; Open gives 3 once, Creator adds 10 a month

fields.name: reviewsLeft
fields.note: open 1, creator 2 a month

fields.name: renews
fields.note: when the month's credits and reviews come back

reads.note: Editor.tsx:54 useLoad(getCreator) (reloads on the store's change event); shown as credit count in AiBar and used by SubmitSheet (planOk, reviewsLeft, extraReviews) and CreditsSheet text. Monthly rollover is done by the client in read() (studio-api.ts:91): reviews reset to REVIEWS[plan], creator plan adds 10 credits; the server must do this by job.

fields.name: looks
fields.note: creator's saved looks (not read in Editor.tsx itself; in Prefs type)

reads.note: Editor reads bottom, span, coached at mount (Editor.tsx:136, 355); Panels/Add tools use looks/recent/fav/addTab through the same getPrefs/setPrefs.

Compiled into the web bundle (lib/engine/packages.ts PACKAGES), NOT read from storage; a style's base must be one of these slugs. The server needs the same slug list to validate base and fallback, and the plan 'needs' (film/stage/drawn/3d) derive from pace and dimension. Not a backend read today.

actions.name: changeStyle (AI change)

payload.name: style
payload.type: StyleSpec (whole style minus status, seen, at; name trimmed)

payload.name: target
payload.type: {scene?: string, layer?: string} (selected element, else {scene: current scene})

expectedResponse.shape: {base?: string, theme?: Theme, scenes?: Record<sceneKey, SceneEdit>, made?: Made, tags?: StyleTags, ops?: StudioOp[], said: string[], credits: number}
expectedResponse.note: AiBar.tsx:41 merges: theme spread over style.theme, scenes spread over scenes (whole SceneEdit replaced per key), made and tags replaced, then ops applied; credits replaces the displayed count; said[0] is the toast ('Done.' if empty). base is in the type but AiBar ignores it. StudioOp = add {scene, bank, at?, with?: Partial<Added>} | change {scene, id, set} | animate {scene, layer, set: Partial<LayerEdit>} | remove {scene, id} | order {scene, id, to up|down|number} | layout {scene, layout} | look {theme, scene?}; 'bank' ids come from components/app/studio/bank (client bank).

actions.name: draftStyle (AI full draft)

actions.name: submitStyle

payload.name: useExtra
payload.type: boolean (true when reviewsLeft<1 and extraReviews>0, decided by the client)

failureReasons: plan (style needs Creator plan: opens plan pay sheet)
actions.serverRules: Today in client: needsCreator(style).length && plan!=='creator' -> plan; (useExtra ? extraReviews<1 : reviewsLeft<1) -> no-reviews; decrement the matching counter; create SubmittedStyle status 'review', submittedAt now, byline = account handle, template false; remove the draft. Submit button is only enabled when every check passes (client-computed) and a name is set; server should re-validate.

notes: The checks in lib/studio.ts:618 (checks()) and lib/studio-checks.ts are the review gate; checks() is pure over the style and runs client-side. lib/studio-checks.ts runChecks mounts scenes in a browser, so cannot run on a server. Server validation can only cover the pure parts (chapters, contrast, budget, still, fallback, safe, plan needs).

StudioHost (components/engine/made/StudioHost.tsx) is how a wish plays a 'studio:<id>' style: it needs the style by id readable by whoever opens the wish link (a receiver with no account), drafts first then sent styles. A server must serve the style document of a live style to receivers; today it only works on the creator's own device.
Layout, motion and bank 'ops' are an open JSON vocabulary; the backend should store scenes and added as validated JSON blobs, not normalised tables.
